(2) The woman gracefully spins toward the camera, revealing a highly detailed gold-embroidered bodice with sheer panels and the words TAIWAN ROC printed clearly on her sash. (4) She pauses to look directly into the camera, blowing a gentle kiss while maintaining a sophisticated pose. The dress swirls around her as she continues her confident walk toward the poolside, with the camera capturing her from various angles.
